chemical engineering.rationale: Process plants generate sensor data; ML helps with monitoring and optimisation.
Process design is central to emissions and waste reduction.
Reaction and separation engineering underpin energy systems.
Mass/energy balances are quantitative modelling — a natural bridge to analytics.

mechanical engineering.rationale: Dynamics, control and mechanics map directly onto robotics.
Predictive maintenance uses sensor data from machines.

civil engineering.rationale: Materials and construction drive environmental impact.
Structural and traffic data support analytics roles.

electrical engineering.rationale: Control systems and embedded electronics are core to robotics.
Signal processing overlaps heavily with ML.

computer science.rationale: Software skills are the main currency of open-source programmes.
Systems and networking knowledge is the foundation.

biotechnology.rationale: Bioinformatics is data analysis on biological datasets.
Lab work leads naturally into research programmes.
